task.title: Phase L milestone L1 (awkit-djnl.1): AI foundation, autonomy policy and performance go/no-go
task.objective: Start L1 per docs/plans/ai-upgrade-v5/L1-ai-foundation.md. This contract covers only the Risk-3 paths L1 must touch: the autonomy policy (src/security/authz/AiAutonomyPolicy.ts, classified authorization_change so T3 and ceiling edits stay lease-gated) and the explicit AI permissions in src/security/authz/Permissions.ts (security lease), the source-controlled model manifest src/offline/AiModelManifest.ts (release lease), and the Beads and routing-matrix bookkeeping (project-state lease). Ordinary L1 code under src/ai, app/main, app/renderer, scripts and docs is unleased direct-loop work, disclosed rather than hidden.

acceptance.description: AiAutonomyPolicy decides observe/suggest/autoApply/forbidden per the ratified table: ceilings equal defaults, configuration only lowers, the T2 cap and the exact T3 list are code constants, T3 is unreachable under every configuration, and self-demotion trips only above the threshold with a minimum sample.
The typecheck and bundles pass with the policy in place.

history.released_reason: AiAutonomyPolicy and AI permissions committed in 9f452e5, verify:ai-autonomy-policy 40/40 with four caught mutations
